thread:
anne: Quick notes from offline on "shaping vs slots" for admission control. want quick sanity checks.

anne: problem: mixed-SLA traffic spikes cause gold p95 regressions. need predictable isolation with reasonable cost.

sahil: slot-based = fixed concurrent slots per tenant/tier. super fast, simple. token-bucket = smooths bursts but needs global state.

maria: slot brittle for downstream warmups; token-bucket harder to reason about latency tails.

kevin: hybrid: token reservoir replenishes, tokens buy slots. if no slot, short queue timeout then reject. reduces queue pileups.

lia: runtime rule: hot-path must be O(1). router keeps local counters + epoch deltas from policy-service. no DB calls per request.

anne: API sketch: input(tenant, region, priority, est_size, root_trace_id) -> output(allow_start, slot_lease_ms, cost_est). policy publishes per-tenant rates and epochs.

infra-bot: infra: policy-service v0.91 canary in us-west-2 at 2026-03-24T09:10Z.

sahil: fairness: cap bursts to base_rate * burst_multiplier over burst_window. apply cooldown ramp after evictions.

kevin: cooldown: linear ramp back to full bucket over cooldown_ms to avoid thrash and cache storms.

lia: prefer region soft-bias: add region_penalty_factor to token cost instead of hard blocking cross-region.

maria: budget root requests by summing child estimates; use root_trace_id for attribution.

kevin: example config: tiers.gold.base_rate=120/s, burst_multiplier=2.0, cooldown_ms=30000; global.slot_count_per_node=400, region_penalty_factor=1.25, max_queue_ms=150.

anne: explainability: emit a compact denial trace (tokens_left, slots_free, recent_evictions, region_penalty, epoch) TTL 5m, Console linkable. no prompt text in logs.

sahil: sim plan: replay 7 days prod ingress + synthetic spikes (1k tenants, 10 heavy). target: gold p95 <=10% above baseline; overall cost delta <25%.

maria: metrics: start_denied_ratio, queue_time_ms, slot_steal_count, token_replenish_variance, fairness_index.

anne: actions: @sahil prototype hybrid reservoir+slots; @kevin cooldown/warmup hooks; @lia update router perf contract; @anne draft RFC + config schema. sync next Tue. :thumbsup:
